passwordPolicy: length(12) and upperCase(1) and digits(1) and specialChars(1) and notUsername

authenticationFlows.description: Customer sign-in with Levels of Authentication: acr 1 password, acr 2 password plus WebAuthn or TOTP (step-up with acr_values=2)
acr 2: a second factor (asked again after the level-2 max age)
WebAuthn (2FA), passkey or TOTP authenticator app
Staff sign-in (console, developer portal): password plus a second factor (acr 2); WebAuthn security key or TOTP authenticator app, enrolment forced on first sign-in
acr 2: a second factor (asked again after the level-2 max age)
WebAuthn security key when registered, otherwise the TOTP app
WebAuthn (2FA) for users who registered a security key
TOTP for everyone else (set-up forced when missing)

realm.name: meridian-service-internal
realm.description: Machine catch-all: a service / integration identity may receive any staff domain scope that is in its own default scope list (keeps svc-* and read-only clients working now that the staff domain scopes are role-gated)

realm.name: CUSTOMER_SUPPORT
realm.description: Front-line support: read-only across customer, accounts, cards, payments, wallets and KYC, plus inbox write to respond to customers.

realm.name: SUPPORT_L2
realm.description: Second-line support: everything L1 can see plus limited writes — card freeze/unfreeze and dispute intake (cards:write) and case notes (servicing:write).

realm.name: OPERATIONS
realm.description: Back-office operations: broad servicing write across accounts, payments, wallets and cards, plus CRM. A standard checker for money-movement approvals.

realm.name: FINANCE
realm.description: Finance / treasury operations: ledger, GL and reconciliation (ledger:write) and treasury (treasury:write), with read on reporting and accounts.

realm.name: RISK
realm.description: Risk and fraud operations: fraud, sanctions screening, cases, limits and transaction monitoring (risk:write) and KYC (party:write), with read on payments, accounts, cards, wallets.

realm.name: COMPLIANCE
realm.description: Compliance / MLRO: KYC (party:write), sanctions and case dispositions (risk:write) and regulatory reporting (reporting:write), with read on payments, accounts and wallets.

realm.name: TELLER
realm.description: Branch / outlet teller: cash-in and cash-out (wallets:write) with account and customer read.

realm.name: AUDIT
realm.description: Read-only everything (every domain :read, which includes audit/platform reads); never writes.

realm.name: MAKER
realm.description: Maker marker role for maker-checker segregation: makers submit changes using their functional role's scopes; this role carries no scope of its own and is referenced by approval policies.

realm.name: CHECKER
realm.description: Checker marker role for maker-checker segregation: referenced by approval policies' approver_roles so a second, suitably-roled person approves. Carries no scope of its own.
